prompt: In a watercolor illustration of a theatre backstage, the scene is bustling with quiet preparation. On the left stands a woman in a blue velvet dress, her posture rigid as she holds a silver mirror. Next to her, on the right, sits a black cat with white paws, grooming itself calmly on a wooden crate. In the center hangs a large golden mask, suspended by a thin rope, catching the dim ambient light. A man in a green vest leans against the wall near the mask, looking at the woman in the blue velvet dress with an expression of anticipation. Beside him, a tall stack of yellow scripts rests precariously on the floor. The woman in the blue velvet dress is pointing at the large golden mask, drawing the attention of the man in the green vest. Nearby, a young boy in striped pajamas sits on the floor, tying the laces of his tap shoes. He is positioned next to the stack of yellow scripts, seemingly oblivious to the adults. The black cat with white paws remains still, ignoring the activity around it. There is no spotlight illuminating the stage area, keeping the focus entirely on the backstage clutter and characters. The soft washes of color blend the background shadows into the foreground figures, creating a cohesive yet detailed narrative of pre-show nerves. The textures of the velvet, wood, and paper are suggested through gentle brushstrokes rather than sharp lines, maintaining the ethereal quality of the medium while clearly defining each distinct element within the cramped space.
